subject: data.open
name: Open government data portal
what_would_settle_it: A public-sector open-data portal or policy document.

subject: gov.policy
name: National AI strategy (Lei da Estrategia Nacional de IA)
what_would_settle_it: A national AI strategy adopted by the Council of Ministers, or the Lei da Estrategia Nacional de IA UNESCO recommends.

subject: gov.legislate
name: Access to information statute
what_would_settle_it: An access-to-information statute creating a request procedure, deadlines, exemptions, appeal or an oversight body.

subject: gov.legislate
name: AI-specific legislation or regulation
what_would_settle_it: An AI-specific law or regulation, or an instrument creating a national AI ethics body.

subject: infra.connect
name: Internet Exchange Point
what_would_settle_it: A PeeringDB listing, an operator announcement or a regulator decision establishing an exchange point.

subject: dpi.registry
name: National address register
what_would_settle_it: Enactment of the postal base law, or any other instrument establishing a national address or postcode database.

subject: finance.sustain
name: 2025 and 2026 budgets, digital lines
what_would_settle_it: The expenditure volumes of the approved OGE 2025 and of the 2026 budget under Lei n. 3/2026, read into the budget extract; only FY2024 is extracted.

subject: finance.sustain
name: Outturn against the digital appropriations
what_would_settle_it: A budget execution report or Conta Geral do Estado for 2024 or 2025 giving execution by project and activity for the digital lines, read into the budget extract.

subject: finance.sustain
name: Financing of the central bank core banking system after project-paid support ends
what_would_settle_it: A central bank budget or statement providing for the core banking system's licensing and support once the two years paid by the Institutional Capacity Building Project run out.

subject: geopol.sovereignty
name: Rule on where state data is hosted
what_would_settle_it: A decree or government hosting policy giving force to INIC's position that vital state data and systems be hosted in national territory.

subject: geopol.sovereignty
name: Data, portability and exit terms of the passport, payment-switch and civil-register agreements
what_would_settle_it: Publication of the INCM passport contract, the SIBS Dobra24 supply contract, or the University of Aveiro and Camoes agreement for SIGA, with their data and exit clauses.
